notes: Web page only; pages are section titles. The evaluation table gives no metric definitions, so metrics are written as 'reported score'; the direction (higher or lower is better) is not stated for safety rows (StrongREJECT, FORTRESS) and was not assumed. Params row left out (setup, not an eval). Cells with a dash were skipped. Combined cells (MCP Atlas public/all, CharXiv RQ original/with python) were split into two results. Dagger marks on HLE, Audio MC and VoiceBench are not explained in the text (no footnote text). Model mapping: 'DeepSeek V4 Flash' -> DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 'Nemotron 3 Ultra' (55/550 params) -> Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B-A55B, 'Claude 4.5 Haiku' -> claude-haiku-4.5, 'Inkling' (41/975) is the larger sibling and is comparison only. No named external testers and no numbers for the dangerous-capability, sycophancy or manipulation tests. Risk decision is a general lab conclusion under no named framework, so no level is set. The 'harmful_requests' and 'over_refusal' headlines rely on the table rows plus a general safety claim.
